utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people do you still need for Saturday, and what kind of help do you want most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I could use about three or four more people, especially someone to greet neighbors, someone handy with small fixes, and someone to keep supplies organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m putting together the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that repair drive is this Saturday on the front porch. I could still use a few helpers if anyone’s free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia. I’d like folks there by 10 a.m., and I’m mainly looking for help with carrying, basic repairs, and keeping supplies sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it. I’ll see who I can send, and I’ll check whether we have enough bins and labels for the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I’m still looking for a few helpers if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I still need a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep asking around and send anyone handy your way for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Come by around 10 on Saturday, and just stay as long as you can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be there around 10 and help as long as I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the helpers and timing for Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia. I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way for Saturday on the front porch.
